Dear reviewers,
Please find our resubmission here. Please note:
・A new letter from our partners at UNDP's Alt Fin Lab re: ongoing commitment to this project, and outlining reasons for delays to date, as well as commitment to finding new ecosystem partners to onboard to the project;
・A new Medium article outlining the benefits of the platform and inviting others in the Cardano ecosystem to support and potentially extend develop; https://blockchainwilldogood.medium.com/original-smart-contract-logic-for-aid-and-development-launched-on-cardano-platform-grants-fund4aid-5580ffdec40d 
・The new homepage has addressed the infographic on the site deployed on mainnet;
・Please note: in the original proposal, there are three milestones – these became four in the final milestone module. Milestone 3 only envisages X2 pilot grants, with no specific ADA value mentioned or required in M3. These begin from M4. We are outlining in ongoing discussions with UNDP Alt Fin Lab and partners how to begin deploying live grants for much larger ADA amounts from M4. 

A. Output: Deploy grants platform on Mainnet 
Acceptance criteria: Product is fully deployed and live on Mainnet 
Evidence: See: https://grants.fund4aid.com/ (Please register as a Grant Manager to test the platform. Super Admin will approve all new Grant Manager registration requests within 24 hours)
B. Output: Outline pilot project with UNDP grants as part of Tadamon Food Security Accelerator 
Acceptance criteria: UNDP report on current and future use of the product 
Evidence: UNDP report on current and future use of the product is available to the community via Google Drive 
C. Output: Test x2 pilot grants on MVP with UNDp Alt Fin Lab
Acceptance criteria: Report on first x2 pilot UNDP grants on platform 
Evidence: Link to report on pilot grants is available to the community via Google Drive
D. Output: Overview of resilience of smart contracts and general tech stack
Acceptance criteria: Report on resilience of smart contracts and g
